line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R2315: retained resource WND does not know the creator compatibility version used by original clmsg for WM_CTLCOLOR selection. A zero WFWIN40COMPAT flag on that copy does not establish a legacy application. Current control-color fallback passes the actual HWND to the native default procedure. This replaces only the provider name; do not generalize its control-window LPARAM conversion to other messages.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.
